Trace, implement and test: 剑指 Offer II 082. 含有重复元素集合的组合

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> candidates;
    vector<vector<int>> ans;
    vector<int> t;
    int target;

    vector<vector<int>> combinationSum2(vector<int>& candidates, int target) {
        sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());
        this->candidates = candidates;
        this->target = target;
        vector<int> t;
        dfs(0, 0, t);
        return ans;
    }

    void dfs(int u, int s, vector<int>& t) {
        if (s > target) return;
        if (s == target) {
            ans.push_back(t);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = u; i < candidates.size(); ++i) {
            if (i > u && candidates[i] == candidates[i - 1]) continue;
            t.push_back(candidates[i]);
            dfs(i + 1, s + candidates[i], t);
            t.pop_back();
        }
    }
};
